feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only exact R84 vehicle/rival rank projected-eye coordinate mapping. Preserve source SpriteNode identity, NaviPub screen ranks, c64/WVP shader ownership, Z/RHW/UV, GOAL, SkyGlow, desktop game input/FFB, R26 rollback and frozen DXVK.

R30 transforms each exact world-marker XYZRHW vertex into two GPU-eye scratch buffers while keeping source Z/RHW/UV and exact producer classification.
Two-eye XR FOV/pose projection and host stereo consume only a fully valid binocular coordinate pair; rejected Reset/invalid-eye input keeps native fallback.

diagnosis.root_cause: R84 rank GPU-eye loop committed eye0 XY before validating eye1; separate float NDC computations could overflow finite viewport intermediates. Scratch writes on rejected second eye were not transactional, even when eventual result returned false.
diagnosis.source_evidence: Source: src/vr/d3d9/stereo_renderer_r30.cpp R30TransformProjectedRankXyzrhwStereo previously assigned dst[0]/dst[1] in an eye loop. src/vr/game/projected_rank_stereo.hpp computed float (mapped+1)*viewport before the final half multiplication.
diagnosis.original_evidence: Existing original-executable Calc3D2D exact vehicle/rival rank producer and SpriteNode queue token are reused; this change introduces no EXE RVA or extra original hook.
source_trace: Original 0xBAEE2 Calc3D2D producer registers per-car view anchor via hooks_uiscaling.cpp.
R30BuildProjectedRankDelta supplies exact shared latched eye shifts to R30TransformProjectedRankXyzrhwStereo.
Paired finite projection publishes left/right XY together before R29 physical stereo submission, retaining original Z/RHW/UV.
alternatives_rejected: Globally turning all XYZRHW/HUD geometry into world ranks would break actual game UI, so change only the corroborated exact projected-world rank branch.
Repeated HMD shader constant rescans do not resolve the deterministic partial-output arithmetic path.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Shared RemapScreenPair validates both eyes before output publication and computes double intermediate NDC; R30 calls it once per source vertex then writes both eye coordinates.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: Existing native vrhost/tests/r84_rank_marker_stereo_smoke.cpp adds NaN right-eye atomic fallback, zero viewport Reset no-write, large finite projection and left/right asymmetry cases.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: Only exact RankMarker/Rival projectedWorldMarker R84 path writes two-eye scratch after complete pair. Native mono fallback remains on rejection; no quest headset acceptance claimed.
